articles.title: India to Host iBRICS Global Sovereign Capital Summit - GKToday
articles.content: Home India to Host iBRICS Global Sovereign Capital Summit India to Host iBRICS Global Sovereign Capital Summit September 5, 2026 Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027 The Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute (SWFI) announced on 4 September 2026 that it will convene the inaugural iBRICS Summit in New Delhi, India. The two-day event is formally titled “The Global Sovereign & Private Deal Room” and is scheduled for 12–13 September 2026 at The Oberoi, New Delhi, on the sidelines of the 18th official BRICS Leaders’ Summit. BRICS and Sovereign Capital BRICS is an intergovernmental grouping of Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa, and it has expanded its agenda to include finance, trade and payment systems. Sovereign capital refers to funds managed by state-owned investment vehicles such as sovereign wealth funds, public pension funds and other public capital pools. Summit Format and Participation The summit is an invitation-only event and is set to host more than 500 institutional investors, finance ministers and business leaders managing a combined $1 trillion in capital. A closed-door roundtable of 250 principals is scheduled for 12 September 2026 to discuss non-dollar settlement corridors and a proposed “Sovereign Capital Compact”. Investment Themes and Payment Systems The transaction-oriented sessions will focus on matching sovereign wealth funds, public pensions and family offices with projects in infrastructure, technology, critical minerals and energy transition. The summit will also address the integration of national fast-payment networks, including India’s Unified Payments Interface (UPI) and Brazil’s Pix, with Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs). Important Facts for Exams The Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute is a global platform that tracks sovereign wealth funds and public investment institutions. Unified Payments Interface is India’s real-time retail payment system developed by the National Payments Corporation of India. Pix is Brazil’s instant payment system launched by the Central Bank of Brazil. Central Bank Digital Currencies are digital forms of sovereign money issued by central banks. Capital Deployment Framework The summit is designed as a deal-making forum for cross-border investment corridors among BRICS economies. The official communication did not disclose specific investment targets or identify the projects that may receive funding.
